style: Detailed pixel art for a cozy indie life-sim game, straight-on front view of a room interior like a dollhouse cutaway (no isometric angle, no perspective tilt), crisp hard-edged square pixels (every art pixel is a clean 4x4 block, no anti-aliasing, no blur), limited palette with 3 to 4 shades per material, kawaii girly maid style. Palette: light blue #6FA8E8 and creamy white #FFFFFF as main colors, navy #2C4A8A accents and ribbons, pale gold #E8D6A0 trims. No text, no letters, no UI, no characters, no people, no living animals (whale motifs as toys, decals and patterns are welcome).

jobs.name: dafeiyu-room
jobs.prompt: An EMPTY girly bedroom background for a 2D game, wide 16:9, seen straight from the front like a dollhouse: the back wall fills the upper 75% of the picture, a little of the left and right side walls shows at the edges, and a cream white wooden plank floor fills the bottom 25% with a perfectly straight horizontal line where the wall meets the floor. The wall is light baby blue (#6FA8E8 tints) with a creamy white lace-trimmed wainscot panel along its lower part and a thin pale gold picture rail. Slightly left of center there is ONE tall arched window with a white frame, through it a calm blue sea and sky with soft clouds; frilly white lace curtains on both sides tied back with navy blue ribbon bows. On the wall: a cute light blue whale wall decal with little water-spout dots, a shell-shaped picture frame, a heart-shaped mirror with a gold rim, a small string of tiny shell bunting. A scalloped shell pendant lamp hangs from the ceiling at the top center. On the floor in the center a light blue whale-shaped rug with white polka dots. IMPORTANT: there is NO furniture at all — no bed, no table, no desk, no chair, no cabinet, no shelf, no TV, no computer, no sofa, no plants on the floor; the wall areas on the left (where a bed will go), in the middle-right (where a desk will go) and on the right (where a record cabinet and a TV stand will go) are plain empty wall with only the wainscot, and the floor in front of them is open. Fully opaque picture, no magenta.

jobs.name: dafeiyu-furniture
jobs.prompt: A sprite sheet of NINE separate pieces of girly maid-style furniture for a 2D room game, laid out in a loose 3 by 3 grid with very wide empty gaps between them (nothing touches, nothing overlaps), every piece seen straight from the front, standing on nothing, on a perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no floor, no shadow, no wall. Row 1: (1) a creamy white princess single bed seen from the front-side, a tall arched headboard on the left end with a navy ribbon bow, a white lace canopy curtain draped over it, a light blue mattress and sheet with white polka dots, a big blue whale pillow, WITHOUT its foot board (the right end of the bed is open); (2) the matching bed foot board alone: a short creamy white panel with two round gold-capped bed posts, a small navy bow and a lace frill, same height scale as the bed; (3) a small creamy white bedside table with one drawer and a gold knob, a shell-shaped lamp on it switched off, the top of the table otherwise empty. Row 2: (4) a creamy white writing desk with curvy legs and a lace table runner, a boxy retro computer monitor with a COMPLETELY BLACK blank screen and a keyboard on it, a light blue chair with a bow tucked in front, a small desk lamp with a lace shade switched off; (5) a low creamy white cabinet with two doors each with a navy ribbon bow, on top a vintage turntable record player with an open lid and an EMPTY platter (no record on it) and a pair of white headphones with a bow hanging on its side; (6) a white TV stand with a retro rounded CRT television on top whose screen is COMPLETELY BLACK, a small white game console and a light blue game controller on the shelf below. Row 3: (7) a big soft light blue beanbag cushion shaped like a smiling whale with a little tail; (8) the same small desk lamp with lace shade switched ON, the shade glowing warm yellow; (9) a small light blue whale plush toy. All pieces at the same scale as each other: the bed is the widest, about 2.2 times as wide as the desk is tall.

jobs.name: dafeiyu-props
jobs.prompt: A sprite sheet of small game props for a girly blue maid room, laid out in a loose 4 by 4 grid with very wide empty gaps between them (nothing touches), every item drawn big and clear, on a perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no shadow. Row 1: (1) a light blue smartphone lying flat seen from the front with a dark screen and a tiny bow charm; (2) the same smartphone held upright with its screen lit up light blue showing a tiny cute whale; (3) a black vinyl record seen from straight above with a light blue center label and a few grooves; (4) a game controller, light blue with white buttons. Row 2: (5) a very WIDE and low light blue quilt blanket seen from the front, its top edge folded back as a creamy white lace frill with a navy ribbon bow in the middle, white polka dots, a gently rounded bottom edge, about four times as wide as it is tall; (6) a navy blue music note; (7) a light blue double music note; (8) a creamy white music note with a gold outline. Row 3: (9) a small round light blue sleep bubble; (10) a bigger round light blue sleep bubble with a white shine (bubbles only, NO letters); (11) a pink heart; (12) a pale gold four-pointed sparkle star. Row 4: (13) a creamy white mug of hot cocoa with a whale print and a little steam; (14) a tiny navy ribbon bow; (15) a small round pearl seashell; (16) a little light blue sparkle.

jobs.name: dafeiyu-screens
jobs.prompt: Five separate pixel-art screen images for a 2D game, on a perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with wide magenta gaps between them, each screen a sharp-cornered rectangle with a 16:11 aspect ratio and NO bezel or frame around it. Top row: FOUR animation frames of a cute side-scrolling mini game, each frame the same size: a light blue sky with tiny white clouds, a little blue whale character jumping in an arc over a grassy and sandy ground that scrolls to the left, round gold coins floating in the air; frame 1 the whale on the ground about to jump, frame 2 rising, frame 3 at the top grabbing a coin with a little sparkle, frame 4 landing, the ground pattern shifted a bit further left in every frame. Bottom row, centered: ONE computer desktop wallpaper of the same aspect ratio, soft light blue with a faint whale silhouette and a column of four small white file and folder icons on the left side, no windows open.
